description: Signature moments: the one reach-past-the-obvious idea per artifact (two at most on long pages). Each is a structural idea, never a look.

cards.name: A rule that becomes the chart axis
cards.borrow: a section rule extends and turns into the baseline of the first chart

cards.name: The headline number is the first bar
cards.borrow: the oversized numeral sits as the first bar of the chart that explains it

cards.name: Traveller shows the real hand-off order
cards.borrow: one marker walks the diagram in the order work actually passed between skills
cards.reduced: marker rests on the final node and the order is numbered

cards.name: An interview phrase set as the display type
cards.borrow: the user's own words become the largest element on the page

cards.name: Failures surface before passes
cards.borrow: the layout orders itself so what failed is the first thing read, passes collapse

cards.name: Before and after share a hinge
cards.borrow: one divider both separates and joins two states, and labels the delta

cards.name: Stale data visibly fades
cards.borrow: age of the data drives saturation, the last update time is the largest label

cards.name: Now, next, not yet
cards.borrow: scope is laid out as three honest columns, nothing in now that eval.md cannot prove

cards.name: Total row pins to the viewport
cards.borrow: the total row of a ledger stays visible while rows scroll beneath

cards.name: Focus lights a dependency chain
cards.borrow: keyboard or pointer focus on a node lights everything upstream and downstream of it

cards.name: The diagram grows as the story advances
cards.borrow: each scroll step adds nodes to the same figure instead of replacing it
